name: advance-codex-dev
description: [DEV] Capability plugin for strengthening Codex surfaces across skills, scenario testing, engineering judgment, response optimization, commits, and plugins.

interface.shortDescription: [DEV] Strengthen skills, engineering judgment, response optimization, scenario testing, commits, and plugins.
interface.longDescription: [DEV] Provides skills for strengthening Codex surfaces: shaping reusable skills, applying problem-solving-centered engineering judgment, optimizing response wording without losing correctness or verification evidence, testing reusable instructions with fixed scenarios and fresh executors, finalizing Codex-made changes into stable commits, and packaging plugins.
defaultPrompt: Use $advance-codex-dev:plugin-creator to package a plugin and define the right bundled surfaces.
Use $advance-codex-dev:skill-creator to design a reusable Codex skill with the right references, guardrails, and description trigger metadata.
Use $advance-codex-dev:skill-scenario-testing to test reusable instructions with fresh subagents, fixed scenarios, and caller-side metrics before reporting evidence-backed findings.
Use $advance-codex-dev:git-committer to prepare and execute a task-scoped commit with commit authority checks, staged verification, commit-message hygiene, and post-commit confirmation.
Use $advance-codex-dev:pro-engineering to apply problem-solving-centered engineering judgment to code changes, root cause analysis, implementation discipline, verification, and risk reporting.

Use $advance-codex-dev:optimize-token to make responses and pre-action thinking shorter and clearer while preserving correctness, verification evidence, approval boundaries, and required output format.
